desc: Fetch today's listing page of the public procurement portal and pull out every new construction-supervision notice as rows of notice id, title and posting date.
Open the 40-page RFP document at the given URL and extract, as plain text, the sections that state the submission deadline, the required licences and the evaluation weights.
From the already extracted RFP text, list every mandatory qualification requirement and score our company 0-100 on how well it meets each one.
Given two RFPs whose text we already hold, compare their evaluation criteria and decide which one our firm is more likely to win, with a numeric qualification score for each.
Write a three-sentence Slack alert telling the sales team that a high-priority RFP was found, formatted for the #sales-alerts channel, and dispatch it.
Draft the 08:00 daily email digest that summarises yesterday's five RFP findings in one line each, with a subject line, and send it to the distribution list.
